title: Cross-validate: Replay window semantics parity
close_reason: Added cross-validation tests for replay window semantics parity: Python test_vectors.py and Rust shared_vectors.rs both now validate against shared test/vectors/replay_window.json. Fixed one incorrect test vector (out_of_order_progressive_window_slide step 9: seqnum 0 at offset 30 should be accepted within 32-slot window). Both implementations produce identical accept/reject decisions for all sequence vectors.
